## Houston v0.6.10

- Installing a skill now keeps your search and results in place, so you can add several without retyping.
- Xiaomi MiMo now gives clearer model guidance and an easy switch when a model is unavailable.
- Linux users can now download the AppImage directly from the Houston website.
- Routines keep their selected provider, and provider reconnects no longer loop on stale status.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
